answer.reason: The Eden verses tell what the serpent did and what happened to it.

clauses.english: beguiled the woman into eating the forbidden fruit, saying she would not die
clauses.quote: The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

clauses.english: was cursed by the LORD God to go upon its belly
clauses.quote: upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat

doubts: REV 12:9 and REV 20:2 call the dragon "that old serpent" and name him the Devil and Satan. Linking the Eden serpent to him is an interpretation, so I left those verses out.
2CO 11:3 repeats that the serpent beguiled Eve, so I did not cite it separately.
